verdict.rationale: An audit trail of ledger changes is a fair question for a bookkeeping service with client-facing software, so the axis applies. The evidence covers automated categorization, real-time reports, downloads and unlimited logins, but nothing records who changed what and when. The QBO-certified option runs inside the customer's QuickBooks account, which is a host-platform capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger
